paragraphs.text: Rehoboam made king. The Israelites by Jeroboam request a relaxation, 2Ch 10:1-5. Rehoboam refusing the old men’s counsel, by the advice of young men, answereth them roughly, 2Ch 10:6-15. Ten tribes revolting, kill Hadoram, and make Rehoboam to flee, 2Ch 10:16-19.
The contents of this chapter are in 1Ki 12$, where see the notes.
or, for (as that particle is oft used, as hath been noted before) they had sent, &c. So this is the reason why he returned, as was said, 2Ch 10:2.
